prompt: A young woman stands in strict right-facing profile, her dark hair pulled into a low bun and her expression composed as a blurred bird sweeps horizontally across her eyes and forehead, wings frozen into translucent motion trails. She wears a tailored deep teal blazer over a high black collar, the finely ribbed fabric absorbing soft highlights while subtle skin subsurface scattering defines her cheek, ear, and lips. A pale blue atmospheric background removes all environmental detail, creating expansive negative space and a surreal editorial composition. Cool, diffuse frontal light produces low-contrast modeling, muted shadows, and a monochromatic cyan-teal palette, while the bird’s motion blur introduces the image’s only strong dynamic gesture. Style: Surrealist fashion editorial photography, minimalist cinematic. Key elements: Woman in profile, motion-blurred bird, teal blazer, low bun, pale blue background. Lighting: Soft diffuse frontal lighting, cool cyan daylight around 6500K. Camera: Vertical medium portrait, 85mm lens, eye-level side profile angle.

promptZh: 一位年轻女性以严谨的右侧面轮廓站立，她 深色头发 梳成低发髻，神情沉静。一只模糊的鸟水平掠过她的眼睛和前额，翅膀凝固成半透明的动态轨迹。她身穿一件剪裁精良的 深青色西装外套，内搭黑色高领衫，细罗纹面料吸收了柔和的高光，而细腻的皮肤次表面散射勾勒出她的脸颊、耳朵和嘴唇。 淡蓝色大气背景 去除了所有环境细节，营造出广阔的留白和超现实的编辑构图。冷色调的漫射正面光产生了低对比度的造型感、柔和的阴影以及单色的青蓝调配色，而鸟的动态模糊则引入了画面中唯一的强动态姿态。风格：超现实主义时尚编辑摄影，极简主义电影感。关键元素：侧面轮廓女性、动态模糊的鸟、青色西装外套、低发髻、淡蓝色背景。光线：柔和漫射正面光，约 6500K 的冷青色日光。相机：竖构图半身人像，85mm 镜头，平视侧面轮廓角度。
